summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class wrapping the translated algebra list. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None), which returns an Update with _original_args set, and SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update unwraps Update objects. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py evalUpdate unwraps Update objects. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (5) test/test_sparql_prepareupdate.py adds four tests covering return type, application to a graph, reuse, and initNs. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed. Risk: Graph.update offers the object to store.update first, so a store expecting a raw string or list could receive an Update object and fail; existing store test suites should be run to confirm.
